content:
More than 1,200 free Thanksgiving meals served in Odessa! 🍂

Peace Academy of West Texas was proud to help organize the 13th Annual Community Thanksgiving Dinner alongside Jesse Porras, the American Legion, and Embrace Relief .

We started with 1,200 plates and had to go get more! The American Legion hall filled up again and again as neighbors came in to share a meal. Volunteers also delivered meals to seniors and first responders who requested them.

A special thank-you to our Peace Academy volunteers and everyone who signed up through our website. From young children and local high school JROTC cadets to an 88-year-old veteran, volunteers of all ages worked side by side to welcome guests and keep the meals coming.

Thank you to Jesse Porras for bringing our community together, to the American Legion for welcoming everyone, and to Embrace Relief for working alongside us. We’re grateful to everyone who helped cook, serve, deliver meals, and clean up, and to every neighbor who joined us at the table.

Happy Thanksgiving from Peace Academy of West Texas!

#PeaceAcademyOfWestTexas #OdessaTX #CommunityThanksgiving #ThankYouVolunteers

City of Odessa, Texas

🍛 Our Cooking Class is back, and this time it’s for a great cause!

Join us on Saturday, December 12 for a ladies-only cooking class where you’ll learn to make authentic Chicken Biryani, fresh Salad, Raita, and Gulab Jamun for dessert.

This class is a fundraiser to support the West Texas Food Bank and local families in our community. Come cook, eat, and give back with us! ❤️

🕒 3–6 PM
💵 $20

A beautiful day of gratitude, friendship, and togetherness! 🍂🧡

Today, Peace Academy of West Texas joined the Connection Christian Church congregation for a wonderful Thanksgiving meal.

Our heartfelt thanks to Pastors Dawn and Joe Weaks and the entire church family for their warm welcome and generous hospitality. We all enjoyed the delicious food, meaningful conversations, and time spent together.

Sharing a table brings us closer and strengthens the friendships that make our community special. We are thankful for you!

content:
A wonderful day of cooking, friendship, and celebration! 🥘💛

Today, Peace Academy of West Texas hosted a cooking class at the (@wtxfoodbank West Texas Food Bank. Together, we prepared delicious maklube and baklava, enjoyed lovely conversations, and shared the meal we made!

We also had the joy of celebrating the birthdays of Kelys H and Leslie Alvarez together. Happy birthday to both of you! Thank you for sharing your special day with us! 🎂🎉

A warm thank-you to our instructors, volunteers, and everyone who joined us, and to the West Texas Food Bank for welcoming us into their kitchen.
